Name: There Was A Fish In The Percolator
Author: Smashley41
Description:
[u][size=6][b]There Was A Fish In The Percolator[/b][/size][/u]

For those of you who love [i]Twin Peaks[/i]!

This mod adds a configurable (default 5%) chance for the Coffee Maker to produce a fish each day. That is pretty rare, hopefully rare enough to put a smile on your face when it happens! You can increase that chance. Have it produce a fish every day if you want, it's your playthrough!

If a fish is produced, it will choose from one of five common, low-value, freshwater fish. If not, it will produce coffee as normal.


[b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure Content Patcher is installed
[*]﻿Add the mod to your Mods folder
[*]I recommend installing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] so that you can edit the mod's config option
[/list]
[b]Compatibility:[/b]
Not compatible with any mod that edits the Coffee Maker's input/output behaviour. Compatible with everything else.

[b]
Translations:[/b]
An i18n file is included. You are welcome to create your own translations under the following conditions...
[list]
[*]You translate the file yourself, without using AI
[*]You upload ONLY the i18n file and NOT the full mod
[*]You list this mod as a requirement
[/list]If you create a translation please let me know, I will add a link to it on this page with credit to its creator.
